versions.content: Safety Extensions do not break AUTOSAR Model Processing Type: valid Description: The usage of Safety Extensions shall not break the processing of existing AUTOSAR models. Rationale: The safety extensions are provided as extensions that can be used in addition to the existing models. This ensures backward compatibility. For some generation purposes, it might not be necessary to include the safety extensions into the generation process to save resources. Use Case: – Dependencies: – Supporting Material:
